apiIntro: Bind public identity data and a face biometric into an encrypted ZelfProof stored on IPFS. Only the matching live face can decrypt it.
heroSubtitle: Bind identity data + face into an encrypted ZelfProof on IPFS.
step1Subtitle: Who this HumanID belongs to and what data it carries.
step2Subtitle: Anchor the proof to a live face.
step3Subtitle: Decide what's required to decrypt this HumanID later. These settings only affect future decrypts — they do NOT remove the face capture above.
identifierHint: A unique handle for this HumanID — usually a username, email, or document number.
unlockLivenessSwitchTitle: Require a live face on decrypt
unlockLivenessSwitchHint: When ON, decrypting needs a real-time camera capture (anti-spoof). When OFF, a still photo of the same person can decrypt — easier for users, but less secure.
unlockToleranceHint: How strict anti-spoof (liveness) checks should be when a live face is required at decrypt. Softer is easier for real users but less resistant to spoofing.
toleranceRegularDescription: More permissive; high-quality photos may pass as “live”. Prefer Hardened when you need to block static images.
toleranceSoftDescription: More lenient liveness — fewer failed checks, slightly higher spoof risk.
toleranceHardenedDescription: Strictest liveness — strongest anti-spoof, may reject some genuine captures.
unlockPasswordHint: Adds a second factor on top of the face. Leave blank for face-only decryption.
publicDataHint: Shown with the proof; all values are sent as strings.
metadataHint: Internal metadata; same string-value rules as public data.
chooseOneDescription: Scan with your camera or upload a photo. Either option works for this step.
cameraSubtitle: Open the camera and align your face in the frame
uploadSubtitle: Select an image file from your device instead
errorPublicDataJson: Public data: fix the JSON (invalid or incomplete), then try again.
errorMetadataJson: Metadata: fix the JSON (invalid or incomplete), then try again.
errorKeysRequired: Public data and metadata need at least one key with a non-empty key name.
errorLivenessFailedBody: This image did not pass liveness verification for HumanID. Use the guided camera or another real-time capture, then try again.
paramTolerance: Liveness strictness when live face is required: REGULAR / SOFT / HARDENED (also REGULAR_HARD, REGULAR_SOFT upstream)
